title: Submission format

workflow.details: For a dedicated workflow decision or sequence edit, use the instructions and request body supplied for that task.

request.details: Use the payload for the token’s action. edit_reason is rejected or user_comment. Keep the existing header for edit and send the current revision_no as expected_revision. Send content or an absolute doc_path in this token’s scratch directory. For a file-based review, doc_path points to JSON with verdict/findings/comment. TR commit_message is one ASCII English line up to 200 characters. On edit it may be omitted to retain a valid saved message. See submit/changed_files.
request.remote_cli: For remote CLI, write the complete body (including review JSON where applicable) to a UTF-8 file in the current working directory. Read it into content and compute body_chars and body_sha256 from that same file. Remote CLI uses content instead of doc_path.
request.rejected_edit: With edit_reason=rejected, provide a nonempty rejection_response separate from content. Carry through the rejection_id or review_id supplied in the mention.

response: Use dry_run=true to validate without registering. Inspect change_summary on save.
errors: On revision conflict reread the latest body. On invalid_commit_message check the TR message format. For encoding refusal see conversation/encoding. A blank rejection_response is rejected with 422 and an unresolved rejection target with 409.
